# context-db

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/context-db
```

Turns the remaining `rasuvaeff/context` budget into a statement timeout the
database server enforces itself. Namespace `Rasuvaeff\Context\Db`.

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `ext-pdo`, `rasuvaeff/context` ^0.3; `ext-pdo_mysql` / `ext-pdo_pgsql` per server.
- `StatementTimeout::for(PDO $pdo, ?Dialect $dialect = null)` detects the dialect:
  driver `mysql` + server version containing "MariaDB" → `MariaDb`, other
  `mysql` → `MySql`, `pgsql` → `PostgreSql`, anything else → `Unsupported`.
- The budget is read BEFORE `assertActive()`: a passing check guarantees ≥ 1 ms,
  never 0 (0 = unlimited to every server). A terminated context throws.
- MySQL limits ONLY read-only SELECT (hint on the main SELECT, also after a
  `WITH` CTE list). DML, `INSERT … SELECT` and DDL run without a server limit.
- An interrupted MySQL `SLEEP()` returns 1 instead of failing — test with real work.
- PostgreSQL has no per-statement syntax: `apply()` throws `LogicException`; use `within()`.
- A PostgreSQL timeout aborts the transaction (`25P02` until rollback) — the caller rolls back.
- pgbouncer (transaction pooling): call `within()` inside a transaction → `SET LOCAL`.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Context;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Db\Dialect;
use Rasuvaeff\Context\Db\StatementTimeout;

$timeout = StatementTimeout::for($pdo);
$timeout->dialect();                         // Dialect::MySql|MariaDb|PostgreSql|Unsupported

$sql = $timeout->apply('SELECT 1', $ctx);
// MySQL:   SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1500) */ 1      (non-SELECT: unchanged)
// MariaDB: SET STATEMENT max_statement_time=1.5 FOR SELECT 1  (any statement)
// Unsupported: unchanged; no deadline: unchanged
// existing MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / max_statement_time keeps the stricter value;
// apply(apply($sql, a), b) === apply($sql, min(a, b))

$rows = $timeout->within($ctx, fn () => $pdo->query($sql)->fetchAll());
// session limit = remaining budget (stricter previous kept), restored afterwards,
// also when the callback throws; PostgreSQL in a transaction → SET LOCAL
// each statement inside gets the budget measured at entry

try { ... } catch (\PDOException $e) {
    throw $timeout->translate($e, $ctx);
}
// server timeout (MySQL 3024, MariaDB 1969, PostgreSQL 57014) and the deadline
// passed or is within 5 ms → ContextExpiredException(previous: $e); else $e
```

yiisoft/db: `StatementTimeout::for($db->getActivePdo())`; the driver error is
`$dbException->getPrevious()` (a `PDOException`).
